_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} kwenye umdlalo we-LinesOfAction.
Izinto zakho zii '{side}', izinto zomgadli wakho zii '{other}'.
Ifomethi yokuhamba: `[b1b3]` (kusuka-kwenye koodinethi ukuya kwenye koodinethi). Uhambo olusemthethweni ludlula ngokwasendle ngokwesimeme, phezulu, okanye ngokwecopho amasquare angakumbi nangakumbi kulungana nomngxuma wemizinto (nganinna ibala) kule msthuba. Ungaweza ukusukuma phezu kwezinto zakho, kodwa hayi kwezinto zomgadli wakho; ukugonga kwenye umgadli wakho ukumthatha. Uphumelele ungena izinto zakho zonke zikuxhumene ngokwezingqongile.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomathi kufuneka ibe yi-e2e4 (ukusuka, ukuya kwiikhonkco).
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Intshukumo kufuneka ibe ngqo okanye nge-diagonal.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Kufuneka uhambise umgama olingana namaqhekeza alandelelanayo.
invalid_move.destination_own: Indawo ekuyiwa kuyo ithatyathwe liziko lethu.
